Nvidia CEO Admits Affair Amid Spy Allegations and Probe

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has admitted to an affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The company has launched an internal probe into the matter, which has also drawn scrutiny from the US Congress and raised concerns about chip exports to China. The scandal involves allegations of espionage and China's AI ambitions, with reports suggesting a "honeytrap" tactic. The situation has also impacted Australian superannuation funds.
